changelog:
Leatherworking Basics: Initial Release

- Provides complete workflows for repairing and creating durable leather goods, covering all planning, project management, and sourcing tasks.
- Generates custom leather patterns and project plans based on user measurements and available tools/materials.
- Features clear human-agent role division: agent handles logistics, user performs all hands-on crafting.
- Includes decision trees for repair vs replace, leather selection, and troubleshooting.
- Supplies ready-to-use templates for project logging, material sourcing, and maintenance reminders.
- Step-by-step protocols and example projects support users from setup through finishing and conditioning.
